# DonorPerfect Downsides

Based on user feedback and reviews, here are the main drawbacks of DonorPerfect:

## **User Interface & Usability**
- **Outdated interface** - Many users find it looks dated compared to modern CRM systems
- **Steep learning curve** - Can be difficult for new users to navigate initially
- **Not intuitive** - Requires significant training to use effectively

## **Reporting & Data**
- **Complex report building** - Creating custom reports can be challenging and time-consuming
- **Limited customization** - Reports may not always format the way you need
- **Data export difficulties** - Some users report challenges extracting data

## **Technical Issues**
- **Slow performance** - Can be sluggish, especially with large databases
- **Frequent updates** - Some users find constant updates disruptive
- **Glitches and bugs** - Occasional technical issues reported

## **Cost**
- **Expensive** - Higher price point, especially for smaller nonprofits
- **Add-on costs** - Many useful features require additional paid modules
- **Less value for money** - Some competitors offer similar features at lower prices

## **Customer Support**
- **Inconsistent support quality** - Mixed reviews on helpfulness
- **Slow response times** - Can take time to resolve issues
- **Training costs** - May need to pay extra for comprehensive training

## **Integration & Flexibility**
- **Limited integrations** - Fewer third-party integrations than some competitors
- **Rigid structure** - Can be difficult to customize for unique organizational needs
